system.notes: Although the Age of Consensus is a “time of peace”, the Imperium is always at war. Garrisons are posted at Gaddoc Monorail Station, aboard the naval destroyer Nightcastle, and at the Premiere’s stronghold (about 1000 troops in total). The military also runs a training camp east of Doskvol for fresh conscripts, along with a prison for draft-dodgers and deserters.
